fc.status.dayMsg:
The sun is still up.
Pick a time between 18:00 and 04:00.
fc.status.goodMsg:
Moonlight and clouds barely get in the way.
A great night to find constellations.
fc.status.normalMsg:
Stars are visible, but moonlight or clouds interfere a little.
Start with the bright constellations.
fc.status.poorMsg:
Clouds or bright moonlight make the stars dim.
Only a few bright stars may show.
fc.status.badMsg:
Stars are hard to see right now.
Try a different time.
